source.note: 1998-99 SPx Finite Basketball hobby product. VCS keeps the complete 210-card flagship checklist and the complete 210-card Radiance and Spectrum parallel checklists intact. Extreme is the 90-card #1-90 1/1 partial parallel. The separately distributed Rookie Update #211-240 is excluded because it was packaged with 1998-99 Upper Deck Series Two rather than SPx Finite boxes.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Hobby; 3 cards per pack; 18 packs per box.
decisions.baseChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-210 remains one VCS ProductSet despite five serial-number tiers: #1-90 regular, #91-150 Star Power, #151-180 SPx 2000, #181-200 Top Flight and #201-210 Finite Excellence. Range-specific print runs are retained in Variant while VCS preserves one collector-facing completion checklist.
decisions.parallelChecklistIntegrity: Radiance #1-210 and Spectrum #1-210 each remain one complete ProductSet. Their range-specific serial numbering is retained per card in Variant rather than splitting either parallel into five VCS sets.
decisions.extremeModeling: Extreme is a genuine 90-card partial parallel of #1-90 only, each serial numbered 1/1, and is therefore modeled as its own 90-card ProductSet.
decisions.mjGameJerseyModeling: Michael Jordan Autographed Game Jersey #SPx-GJ is included as the product's one-card insert issue. AU, memorabilia and hand-numbered-to-23 details belong in Variant, not Player.
decisions.rookieUpdateExclusion: Rookie Update #211-240 and its Radiance/Spectrum parallels are not part of SPx Finite pack ripping in VCS because those cards were distributed in 2-card packs included with 1998-99 Upper Deck Series Two boxes. They are intentionally excluded from this product.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: No #1-210 SPx Finite cards receive RC. The recognized 1998-99 rookie cards are in the separately distributed Rookie Update, which is excluded from this product.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean player/card subject plus permitted short collector abbreviations when appropriate. STP, SPX, TF, FE, SN, AU, MEM and descriptive metadata are stored in Subset/Variant rather than copied into Player.
decisions.oddsPlacement: No unsupported pack ratios are inferred from print runs. Pack odds remain null for Radiance, Spectrum, Extreme and the Michael Jordan Autographed Game Jersey unless a trustworthy pack-odds source is established. Serial-number scarcity is preserved in Variant and bundle notes.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images, pricing and final odds review are complete.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete #1-210 flagship checklist. Subsets and serial-number tiers are retained in card metadata; all 210 cards remain one VCS completion set.

productSets.name: Radiance
productSets.notes: Complete #1-210 Radiance parallel. Serial numbering varies by checklist range and is stored card-by-card in Variant.

productSets.name: Spectrum
productSets.notes: Complete #1-210 Spectrum parallel. Serial numbering varies by checklist range and is stored card-by-card in Variant.

productSets.name: Extreme
productSets.notes: Partial parallel #1-90 only; every card serial numbered 1/1.

productSets.name: Michael Jordan Autographed Game Jersey
productSets.notes: #SPx-GJ Michael Jordan autograph/game-worn 1992-93 jersey card, hand numbered to 23. No unsupported pack ratio inferred.
